page_title: CC Switch 官方网站 - AI 编程工具统一管理平台

summary.name: CC Switch
summary.one_liner: CC Switch is a free, open-source desktop app that manages provider configs, local routing, MCP servers, Skills, prompts, sessions and usage stats across about 13 AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI.
use_cases: Switch between API providers for Claude Code or Codex without hand-editing config files
Route Claude Code requests through a local proxy to use GPT or other model formats
Set up automatic failover to a backup provider when the main one errors or is rate-limited
Share MCP servers and Skills across several AI coding tools from one place
Track token usage, cache hits and cost per provider across AI coding tools
Browse and search past AI coding session history and copy resume commands
summary.what_it_does: CC Switch provides one desktop interface for provider configurations across about 13 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and OpenClaw. It includes 90+ built-in provider presets, so users can pick one, enter a key and switch without editing JSON, TOML, YAML or .env files. An optional local router converts between Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini API formats, and a circuit breaker and failover queue switch to backup providers when the main one fails. MCP servers, Skills and prompts are added once and synced to chosen tools, and session history can be searched. Usage statistics come from session logs, with date filtering, custom model prices and subscription quota display.
notable: Unified management of about 13 AI coding tools from one app
Local routing with API format conversion and failover queue
MCP, Skills and prompts configured once and synced per tool
Config and API keys stored locally in SQLite, with optional WebDAV or S3 sync
caveats: Local routing and format conversion require enabling the local proxy, and the page does not detail setup limits
Usage and cost tracking depends on session records and user-entered model prices
Third-party API relay services are promoted as sponsors on the page
